File Pic taken in May 2015. Pictured left to right are brothers Keane (13), Kallum (10) and Brandon (15) Barrett from Drogheda. All three boys have a rare genetic syndrome called Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome (EDS) which effects all the connective tissue in their body including joints, ligaments and internal organs. On Friday Christy Dignam and Joe Jewell played a fundraising gig in aid of the Barrett boys even though they had been invited to play with U2 at the 3Arena. The boys parents Mary and Ian will be forever grateful to Christy and Joe. Picture Ciara Wilkinson.

Chesapeake Swan Song: From Commodity to Conservation explores the interwoven story of swans and people on the Chesapeake Bay through a selection of swan decoys, photos, artifacts, and ephemera from the 19th and 20th centuries. The exhibition opens at the Chesapeake Bay Maritime Museum in St. Michaels, MD on Saturday, April 11, 2015 and continues through April 3, 2016. Photo courtesy C. John Sullivan.
